roster.title: Rosters
roster.addHelp: Add rotation rules (weekday or shift rules) in the Rotation rules tab after creating the roster.
roster.name: Roster name
roster.deleteMessage: All of its rotation rules, placements, holidays, shared departments and assignees will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
roster.empty: No roster is assigned to you.
roster.emptyManage: No rosters yet. Use [Add roster] to create one.

rules.help: A roster can have several rules (in creation order). Every rule that applies on a day places its people, and the duty status shows only the people, not rule names. Editing a rule does not change existing placements; fill the month again to change them.

kindHelp.WEEKDAY: Places one person per apply day in order. If you need N people a day, create N rules. (e.g. Weekdays, Weekends & holidays)
kindHelp.SHIFT: Set the shifts (e.g. day, evening, night) and a pattern (e.g. D E N off); each person moves one cell a day from their start cell. Works for 2-, 3- or 4-team rotations.

rules.kindFixed: The type cannot be changed after the rule is created.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.nameHelp: 1-30 characters, unique within this roster. The name is shown only on this edit screen.
rules.daysEmpty: Choose at least one applicable day.
rules.membersHelp: Select active people in the org chart below and set the order with up/down. Deactivated people may stay but are skipped when filling a month.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Use [Add rule] to create one.
rules.deleteMessage: Placements of this rule from tomorrow on are deleted. Placements up to today remain.

shift.offHelp: A shift type used in placements cannot be removed, and its off-duty mark cannot be changed.
shift.startCellOut: A start cell is outside the pattern. Choose it again.
shift.patternTextBad: '{char}' is not a short label of this rule. (Off is "비")
shift.checkOk: Every day of one cycle matches the set headcount.
shift.checkMiss: Days in one cycle ({days} days) that differ from the set headcount:

placement.help: Select cells, then use the buttons below. To swap, select two cells in the same rule, or two cells in different weekday rules. Past days can be changed too. Use arrow keys to move between cells.
placement.noRules: There are no rules. Create one in the Rotation rules tab.
placement.sameRuleOnly: Swap two cells in the same rule, or between weekday rules only.
placement.filledSkipped: The month was filled. Skipped rules: {list}

skip.NO_APPLY_DAY: no applicable day in the month

fill.title: Fill month
fill.help: Every rotation rule of this roster fills the chosen month from the first fill day to the end. Placements of those rules in that period (including manual ones and those on non-apply days) are cleared and refilled. Past days are not filled.

skip.NO_APPLY_DAY: no applicable day in the month

fill.rulePreview: Places on {place} day(s) and overwrites {overwrite} day(s) that had placements.
fill.noRules: There are no rules. Create one in the Rotation rules tab.
fill.nothing: No rule can be filled (all are skipped).
fill.overwriteDays: Deletes the placements on {count} day(s) and fills them again.
fill.noOverwrite: There are no placements to overwrite.
fill.emptyHolidayDays: Days left empty because there is no "Holiday" rule: {dates}
fill.mismatches: Days where the computed headcount differs from the set headcount:
fill.inactiveSlots: Cells left empty by deactivated people:
fill.fromHelp: You can pick any day of the month from today. Placements before it stay.
fill.previousNone: No previous duty → first in order
fill.confirmCheck: I confirm clearing the placements above and refilling

holiday.help: System holidays were copied when the roster was created. Days treated as Saturday or Sunday go to rules with that day, and days treated as holidays go to rules with "Holiday". Excluded days are treated as normal days. Changes do not alter existing placements or the calendar's red days.
holiday.addHelp: Add temporary holidays and the like. The same date cannot be added twice.
holiday.name: Name
holiday.refill: Days already placed stay as they are. To apply this, fill the month again on the Placement tab.

share.help: Members of the roster's department (excluding sub-departments) see it. Members of shared departments also see it, and with "Include sub-departments" on, their sub-departments too.

assignee.help: Assignees edit this roster's rotation rules, month fills, manual changes, holidays and shared departments. Only active people in the department and its sub-departments can be chosen; the assignment ends on transfer, department move or account deactivation.

editor.weekdayHow: Places one person per apply day in the order below. If you need several people a day, create that many rules with the same apply days.
editor.shiftHow: First set the shifts (name, short label, people per day), then the order one person goes through as a pattern. e.g. 2-shift D N off off, 3-shift D E N off, 4-team 3-shift D D E E N N off off.
editor.typeInPattern: "{name}" is used in the pattern and cannot be removed. Take it out of the pattern cells first.
editor.patternTextHelp: Type the short labels in order (e.g. 주야비휴). Press [Apply] to replace the cells below.
editor.shiftMembersHelp: Choose which pattern cell each person starts at. People starting at the same cell rotate together as a team. Spread in order gives cells 1, 2, 3 ….
editor.previewHelp: An example from the rule alone (holidays and continuing from earlier records are left out). Place duties with Fill month on the Placement tab.
editor.previewWait: Fill in the fields above to see the preview.
editor.needDays: Choose at least one apply day.
editor.typeNeedShort: Enter a short label (1-2 characters) for {name}.
editor.typeCount: {name}: daily headcount must be 1–99 (off duty has none).
editor.typeDuplicate: Shift names or short labels overlap.
editor.patternNoDuty: Put at least one shift that is not off duty in the pattern.
editor.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
editor.offHow: Make rest days such as off (비) or leave (휴) shift types too, and turn on [Off duty]. Off-duty types fill pattern cells but are never placed, so they don't appear in the duty status, calendar or Excel and are left out of headcount checks.
editor.offLocked: This shift type is used in placements, so its off-duty mark cannot be changed.
editor.patternBlank: Choose a shift type for every empty pattern cell.
